# OVERVIEW

## Row 1 - Basic Data {height=150px}

### Current Week
```{r}
#| content: valuebox
#| title: CURRENT WEEK
cur_schedule <- schedule %>% filter(!is.na(home_score))
cur_week <- max(cur_schedule$week)
list(value = cur_week)
```

### Highest Rating
```{r}
#| content: valuebox
#| title: HIGHEST RATING
highest_rating <- max(final_ratings$total)
list(value = highest_rating)
```

### Lowest Rating
```{r}
#| content: valuebox
#| title: LOWEST RATING
lowest_rating <- min(final_ratings$total)
list(value = lowest_rating)
```

### Average Rating
```{r}
#| content: valuebox
#| title: AVERAGE RATING
avg_rating <- mean(final_ratings$total)
list(value = round(avg_rating, 2))
```
